verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI evaluation and observability SaaS with an API and an MCP server, so scoped agent credentials is a fair question for it. The pack only shows that a real token is used against the API (an auth get-token endpoint). Nothing documents issuing scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API keys. The 'project-scoped' setting applies to metrics, not credentials, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
